organic_treatment: Apply organic copper fungicides early. Prune affected leaves, avoid overhead watering, and practice strict crop rotation.
report: Small, water-soaked dark lesions on leaves and fruit that turn brown and scab-like. Leaves yellow around spots

organic_treatment: Spray copper soap or Bacillus subtilis. Prune lower branches to improve airflow and apply mulch to prevent soil-splash.
report: Concentric rings ("target spots") with yellow halos starting on older, lower foliage

organic_treatment: Maintain consistent watering, balanced compost nutrients, and clear row spacing to prevent disease onset.
report: Vigorous green leaves, strong stems, no dark spots, curling, or fungal fuzz.

organic_treatment: Remove infected plants immediately (cannot be cured once established). Preventatively apply organic copper spray in cool, wet weather.
report: Rapidly spreading dark, greasy leaf lesions and firm, brown rot on fruit. White fungal fuzz appears in high humidity.

organic_treatment: Increase greenhouse ventilation and drop humidity below 85%. Apply bio-fungicides like Bacillus amyloliquefaciens or neem oil.
report: Pale yellow spots on upper leaf surfaces paired with olive-green to grey fuzzy mold on the undersides.

organic_treatment: Control whiteflies (the virus vector) using insecticidal soaps, neem oil, or yellow sticky traps. Remove and destroy infected plants.
report: Upward curling leaves, yellow margins, severe plant stunting, and flower drop.
